tasks.title: VTX power and range
tasks.statement: The video transmitter's power was raised from **{p1} mW** to **{p2} mW**. How many times does the free-space range grow?
tasks.solution: Received power falls off as 1/d², so range ∝ √P: every +3 dB (×2 power) gives ×1.41 range.

tasks.title: Intermodulation of two transmitters
tasks.statement: Two VTXs side by side: **{f1} MHz** and **{f2} MHz**. Find the lower third-order product 2f₁ − f₂ (MHz).
tasks.solution: The third-order products 2f₁ − f₂ and 2f₂ − f₁ sit away from the pair by the same spacing. If such a product lands on a third pilot's channel (on an evenly spaced grid — exactly on the adjacent one), that pilot gets lines and snow even though all the frequencies are “different”. Outside the 5.8 GHz band it is harmless.
